_about: W2-GATHER rare drops and butcher yield scaling. Owned by game/scripts/gather/. Every item id must exist in items.json (t_gather checks). Chances are per gathered unit / per carcass and are illustrative defaults, kept configurable here (spec 12 sections 1-2, spec 04).
_assumption: ASSUMPTION: the PRDs give no gather rare odds; these are the simplest numbers that make a rare find happen a few times per session (about one per 25 units of wood or stone).

gather_rare._skill_bonus: 0 by spec 12 s1: 'never silently grant rare material traits purely for reaching a high level'. Better tools raise the odds (ASSUMPTION); skill level does not.
gather_rare._climates: A find rolls only on a node whose island climate lists it (docs/design/world-design.md:66-75, climates.json materials): home grassland never gives flint (temperate) or copper_ore (desert). ASSUMPTION: berry_seed and spice_herb follow berries/herb_leaf (grassland, temperate), flax_seed follows the flax craters (savannah, temperate); silver_ore is snowfield only, so the black-iron row waits for a snowfield black-iron node.

butcher._part_gates: Parts a knife below this tier cannot cut free; they stay out of the carcass loot. ASSUMPTION: Durango gates parts by Butchering nodes (spec 12 s2); until W2-BUTCHER lands those nodes the knife tier stands in.
